description.value: Swiss Sunset Inn is a motel located on Skaha Lake Road in Penticton, a popular cycling destination in BC's Okanagan region. Positioned near Skaha Lake, it sits along a corridor frequently used by touring cyclists on routes such as the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and Okanagan wine country loops. The motel format typically offers ground-floor rooms and on-site parking, which can be convenient for cyclists with loaded bikes.
